page_title: HEI 2-1 FRE | Heidenheim v Freiburg 06/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Heidenheim take a short corner kick.
90+4' 2 - 1 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 2:1.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' The attendance for today's match is 15000.
89' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
89' Noah Atubolu pulls off a great save to block a header from Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) after a nice lofted cross.

89' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Niklas Dorsch departs the field of play to be replaced by Luca Kerber (Heidenheim).
87' Florian Exner shows a yellow card to Anthony Jung (Freiburg) for his blatant foul.
86' Freiburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
84' Julian Schuster has decided to make a change. Christian Gunter (Freiburg) replaces Lukas Kubler.
83' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) fires a volley towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
83' Substitution. Marnon Busch will be replaced by Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim).
81' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
80' Freiburg fail to score from a corner as Diant Ramaj (Heidenheim) leaps to collect the ball.
80' Close! Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
74' Freiburg keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
71' Max Rosenfelder has picked up an injury and is replaced by Anthony Jung (Freiburg).
71' Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
70' A substitution has been made. Julian Niehues goes off and Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) comes on.
67' The manager makes a subsitution with Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) coming on for Vincenzo Grifo.
67' Julian Schuster has decided to substitute Johan Manzambi and he is replaced by Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg).
64' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
64' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
63' Heidenheim work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
59' 1 - 1 Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and with a precise low drive puts the ball into the bottom right corner.
58' Heidenheim take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
56' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
54' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
53' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
52' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Noah Atubolu, who smothers the ball.

49' Heidenheim slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
47' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
46' Julian Schuster has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Max Rosenfelder comes on the pitch for Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg).
46' Frank Schmidt makes a half-time substitution. Tim Siersleben comes on in place of Thomas Keller (Heidenheim).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) comes off for Arijon Ibrahimovic.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Florian Exner has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Heidenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
40' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) tries his luck from the edge of the box and scores with an accurate shot inside the left post. Philipp Treu provided an assist for the goal.
40' The possession of the ball – 30:70.
37' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
35' Florian Exner blows his whistle as Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
33' None of the Heidenheim players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

33' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Heidenheim force a corner. They send men into the box.
31' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Florian Exner stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
31' The corner is swung in but Heidenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

30' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Heidenheim force their opponents to concede a corner.
29' The ball is cleared after Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
25' Wonderful movement by Freiburg. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
23' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) wins the ball from the corner and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but it's a soft effort and drifts well past the left post.
23' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
21' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort well wide of the left post.
19' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) leaps to meet the corner, but fires his header back across goal from close in and it goes well wide of the left post.
19' There's an opportunity for Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
18' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Heidenheim was in an offside position.
17' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) is penalised for a foul. Florian Exner had a clear view and blows his whistle.
16' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
15' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post.
14' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
13' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Thomas Keller (Heidenheim) was quite harsh and Florian Exner didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
10' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Thomas Keller (Heidenheim), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the left post. What a chance!
9' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
7' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) trips an opposition player and Florian Exner signals a foul.
6' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
6' Freiburg are seeing far more of the ball now.
4' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
3' Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) picks up an injury.
2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Heidenheim comes to nothing.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Heidenheim will take the kick-off.
Florian Exner will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
